title: 2.5" Aluminum Intercooler Piping Kit (Mandrel Bent, Silicone Couplers & T-Clamps)
description: Ideal for custom turbo routing and DIY intercooler setups, this universal 2.5-inch piping kit provides the essential mandrel-bent aluminum tubing needed to connect your front-mount intercooler to the throttle body and turbo outlet. Made from lightweight 6061 aluminum with 1.8mm wall thickness, each 18-inch section features bead-rolled ends to keep couplers from blowing off under high boost pressures. The package includes straight, 90°, 135°, and U-bend pipes designed to maintain uniform inner-diameter cross-sections during tight engine bay bends, preventing restrictive airflow bottlenecks. Complete with 8 multi-ply reinforced silicone couplers capable of handling 30+ PSI without expanding, along with 16 heavy-duty stainless steel T-bolt clamps to ensure leak-free seal integrity under load
